sentences.text:
Learned counsel appearing for the appellants submits that in respect of the similar acquisition,
already in the connected matters order was set aside and the matters were remanded back to the Reference Court for consideration.
While remanding the matter, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court had permitted the appellant to make the second respondent as a party before the Reference Court.

Considering the order passed by the Co-ordinate bench of this Court in M.S.A.No.68/2023 arising out of the very same land acquisition proceedings, this Court is passing the following:
ORDER i.

The order dated 11.01.2016 in L.A.C.No.8/1999 passed by the Additional Senior Civil Judge & CJM, Tumakuru, is set-aside and the matter is remanded back to the Reference Court for fresh disposal in accordance with law.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the order passed by the Co-ordinate bench of this Court in M.S.A.No.68/2023 arising out of the very same land acquisition proceedings, this Court is passing the following:
ORDER i.
The order dated 11.01.2016 in L.A.C.No.8/1999 passed by the Additional Senior Civil Judge & CJM, Tumakuru, is set-aside and the matter is remanded back to the Reference Court for fresh disposal in accordance with law.
ii. Beneficiaries shall be made as a party before the Reference Court.
iii. Liberty is reserved to both the parties to adduce evidence in further if they are so advised, either oral, documentary or both.

2 orders within a period of six months from thereon.

viii. All I.As. in this appeal shall stand closed.
